comments.nelsongay: Made all over C&D three weeks ago; more needed to defy his 3lb rise

horses.owner: D P Van Der Hoeven & D G Pryde

races.drawBiasExplanation: High draws favored in sprints, especially on soft ground

verdict.comment: John L Sullivan has more to offer this year but INANNA won well over C&D this month and can defy a small weights rise.

comments.carltonandco: Perhaps sharper with her reappearance behind her but best form has come at sprint trips
comments.clasina: Beaten favourite in both starts this year, latterly behind Inanna over C&D three weeks ago
comments.dwindlingfunds: Big step forward in new cheekpieces 3 weeks ago (6f); goes handicapping at realistic level
comments.goldenvalour: 1m win on this card last year; yet to shine in two starts this season
comments.inanna: Beat a few of these when winning over C&D three weeks ago; solid claims up just 2lb
comments.johnlsullivan: Talented for the grade; had a wind op since last seen in November; can rate higher in 2025
comments.leapday: Poor strike-rate but he's finished second in both starts this year; in the mix once more
comments.littleempire: Course win (1m) last year; 10lb higher but he's been threatening at Dundalk this year
comments.moyola: Not at best when last seen and was given a second wind op; fair mark but stamina to prove
comments.pallaslord: Hasn't transferred his good AW form back to turf this spring
comments.roaringralph: On a lowly mark but he needs to bounce back from a quiet 6f run last month
comments.rory: Capable on his day but he needs to bounce back from a low-key run at Catterick last week
comments.sirgarfield: C&D winner; won an apprentice race at Catterick last week; solid claims off same mark
comments.traisfluors: The old man of the party but retains ability and was third to Inanna over C&D last time

races.raceComment: sirgarfield is marginally preferred with a score of 62.2%, holding clear edges in better ratings over inanna. Won 2 of last 6 starts. Ground (Good To Firm) looks ideal with 2 wins from 8 starts in similar conditions. Key attributes include positive comments, though step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: Extrication has untapped potential over 1m but there should be no excuses for A MAJOR PAYNE this evening.

comments.amajorpayne: Excuses are starting to wear thin but a decent early pace should see him come into it late
comments.ageofbaroque: Second start for Marco Botti with Hollie Doyle taking over from 7lb claimer
comments.arctician: Likely to show his true self this evening for all he may be vulnerable in the finish
comments.billsbaar: Probably best watched on recovery mission/return to action
comments.charencey: Looks one for another day (probably over a furlong shorter on turf)
comments.cityofyork: Should be all the better for his return and this C&D winner is well treated at present
comments.extrication: Pleasing return over 7f here a fortnight ago and has untapped potential for 1m
comments.hodler: Towards the foot of the list in trying to capitalise on a lower AW mark
comments.lawsupreme: Chance, for all he might not come on bundles for C&D return two weeks ago
comments.monopolise: 3-4 over C&D and could put latest effort behind him if fully tuned up
comments.radiantbeauty: Finished weakly the last twice and bouncing back emerging from stall 14 won't be easy
comments.rhythmnrock: Runner-up off 17lb higher in this race last year (it was a 0-85 then); well out of sorts
comments.royalpleasure: Form chance on last-time-out second but isn't one for maximum faith
comments.tex: Yard could hardly be in better form and he's a handicap debutant to note

races.raceComment: cityofyork is marginally preferred with a score of 52.9%, holding clear edges in more progressive over monopolise. Placed in 2 of last 6 starts. Going is a significant concern - yet to win on Standard To Slow ground from 5 attempts. Likely to be steadily run with pressure on the leader. Key attributes include optimal distance, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

races.drawBiasExplanation: Low draws favored on polytrack, particularly in sprints

verdict.comment: The vote goes to SAYIDAH HARD SPUN, who has leading claims on her promising run at Ascot and represents a yard that won this last year.

comments.cloudbuster: Well bred but she's drawn out wide and this looks a tough enough starting point
comments.coinincaisc: Promising third at Bath and she should know more over this longer trip; not ruled out
comments.jenniferjane: 50,000euros yearling; has plenty of speed in pedigree and she needs watching in market
comments.madamex: Went close on recent Salisbury debut and she's in the mix on this step up in trip
comments.mareoflondon: Didn't show much on Ripon debut last month and can only be watched after that 16l defeat
comments.museumpiece: Got her act together with clearcut win at Wolverhampton and she's respected under penalty
comments.mysticmoment: Has lots of stamina in pedigree and she could be one for longer trips later on
comments.nospritznoparty: Has good standard to aim at on debut and she could be a longer-term prospect
comments.resalah: Half-sister to six winners but yard yet to get off mark with 2yos this term; down the list
comments.sayidahhardspun: Promising fourth on Ascot debut and she's open to progress upped in trip; interesting
comments.tobah: £60,000 half-sister to some useful winners; needs a close look on debut

races.raceComment: museumpiece is marginally preferred with a score of 26.9%, holding clear edges in better ratings and more proven at trip and better suited by conditions and superior course form over madamex. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter. Excellent course form of 1/3 at kempton, though step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: Ed Dunlop's PRESSURE'S ON is taken to build on his promising second at Wolverhampton in March.

comments.alameen: Two 7f wins and a running-on fifth over 6f here of late; more to do off revised mark
comments.bishopscrown: These conditions might make bouncing back difficult
comments.farasilane: Percentage call is to oppose given 1m is probably his best trip; drawn wider than ideal
comments.followyourheart: Could easily secure win number three of the year back on AW
comments.habrdi: Hopes pinned on him returning to AW (he's 2-4 on artificial surfaces)
comments.hieronymus: Type to bounce back, particularly if getting his own way in front (could happen)
comments.newsreader: Perhaps best watched returning from a break with 7lb claimer up
comments.nibrasangel: Pleasing stable debut but might again get going too late
comments.pitney: Stable debut; do well to land a race as competitive as this off a 249-day break
comments.pressureson: Fancied to build on earlier promise and make it 2-2 under Hector Crouch
comments.racingbreaksryder: Major question mark over his affinity with AW; low down the list
comments.silversamurai: Lot to like and can play a part if it sets up for the closers
comments.tigercrusade: Same excuse the last twice but has won just once in getting on for two years
comments.wobwobwob: Yet to do it on AW and is drawn wide

races.raceComment: alameen is marginally preferred with a score of 54.6%, holding clear edges in better ratings and more reliable profile over pressureson. Won 2 of last 6 starts. Going is a significant concern - yet to win on Standard To Slow ground from 10 attempts, though step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: This looks good for DRAMA (nap), whose two C&D wins last year represent extremely strong form. Tan Rapido can chase him home.

comments.albarez: C&D win last spring; solid second at Wolverhampton last month; should be involved
comments.albertcee: Best efforts give him claims but he needs to leave a low-key stable debut behind him
comments.bright: Did well in the second half of 2024, winning three; returns from a short break; considered
comments.brunelcharm: Conditions fine but he's up in class and needs to leave a low-key run at Lingfield behind
comments.drama: Boasts strong C&D form; good third in a Southwell 0-95 latest; big chance down in class
comments.liosa: 2-2 over C&D and impressed last month; latest turf defeat excusable; could yet rate higher
comments.manyastar: Three 6f Tapeta wins this year; held his form since but others perhaps better treated
comments.nightonearth: Well-handicapped front-runner but 6f likely to stretch his stamina
comments.scarboroughwarning: Big improver when last seen in October; 10lb better off with Liosa for 0.5l on latest run
comments.tanrapido: Best effort to date when 2nd at Southwell (5f) last month; return to 6f a plus; up 2lb

races.raceComment: liosa is marginally preferred with a score of 59.8%. Won 3 of last 6 starts. Ground (Standard To Slow) looks ideal with 2 wins from 7 starts in similar conditions. Key attributes include optimal distance, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: After an improved second on his handicap debut and now sent over a trip that could suit, TATMEEN gets the nod.

comments.aikhal: Close up over 9.4f latest and that trip was on the short side for one with form over 1m6f
comments.apachecanyon: Won over 1m3f at Southwell in October but has offered precious little since then
comments.autumnsbreeze: Best run yet was her 2nd at Yarmouth, having previously been 0-4 here; off since October
comments.cloudsiderock: Lightly raced; close up over 1m4f two runs back and 1m6f perhaps a stretch last time
comments.cornishstorm: Competitive under both codes this year and he's a C&D winner
comments.dorsetlady: No form, Flat or hurdles, for current yard; wind op needs to turn things around
comments.goldsouk: Respected on old form but finished right out the back in both races after a long absence
comments.goodeye: 50-1 for handicap debut at Pontefract (1m) and was never involved after starting slowly
comments.lawnranger: Usually saves his best for Windsor and this 10yo's powers would appear to be on the wane
comments.marinakis: Consistent on the AW this year and didn't get the breaks when upped to 1m4f last time
comments.onemilliondreams: Minor form under both codes but Hollie Doyle is booked for handicap debut
comments.sneakyblinder: Proven here and ran okay last week at Bath in a race that wasn't run to suit
comments.starfighter: Capable on his day but Wolverhampton is very much his scene and he's 0-6 here
comments.tatmeen: Improved 2nd over 1m on handicap debut; there are 1m4f winners in the family

races.raceComment: sneakyblinder is marginally preferred with a score of 53.7%, holding clear edges in more proven at trip and more progressive over cornishstorm. Won 2 of last 6 starts. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter. Key attributes include optimal distance, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: Several have possibilities but the vote goes to SEA OF CHARM, who beat an unexposed improver over C&D last time.

comments.etonblue: C&D winner who is on a dangerous mark but his last win was in September 2023
comments.galileoscompass: Nine-race maiden for three different yards and he's struggled in last four runs
comments.markethouse: Record of 31122 in AW handicaps for new yard and he looks interesting back on the Flat
comments.prideofnepal: Only 1lb higher than for his C&D win in September and could revive on this return to turf
comments.seaofcharm: Beat an improver over C&D two weeks ago and a 3lb rise looks fair; big player
comments.standbackandlook: Completed a 1m6f double at Wolverhampton last summer but he's lost his way since then
comments.versatile: Cashed in on reduced mark at Bath (1m2f) last week and he's respected under a penalty

races.raceComment: prideofnepal is marginally preferred with a score of 53.7%, holding clear edges in better suited by conditions and stronger recent form and superior course form over etonblue. Won 2 of last 6 starts. Ground (Good To Firm) looks ideal with 5 wins from 21 starts in similar conditions, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: The progressive HAVANA MOJITO can go in again after winning here last month. Local Bay is second choice.

comments.havanamojito: Goes well here and landed his second course win last month off 8lb lower mark.
comments.invinciblenavy: 0-15 and no signs that things are about to change.
comments.localbay: Showed he was on the way back when runner-up here three weeks ago.
comments.mashaan: Respectable second of five back on turf over C&D 13 days ago and place claims once again.
comments.purefoy: Inauspicious seasonal/stable debut when last of five over C&D 13 days ago.
comments.starsong: Second of seven over 7.5f at Beverley 16 days ago; holds claims.
comments.thanksdad: Didn't appear to handle the camber when fourth over C&D three weeks ago.
comments.tronido: Back on turf for the first time since last September but others preferred.
comments.undercurfew: Scored at Wolverhampton in February but all nine wins have been between 5f-6f.
comments.voltaic: Ran well when third to Havana Mojito here before a good second over C&D three weeks ago.

races.raceComment: voltaic is marginally preferred with a score of 59.6%, holding clear edges in more progressive and more reliable profile over havanamojito. Placed in 3 of last 6 starts. Strong pace likely with multiple front-runners. Key attributes include optimal distance and positive comments, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.
